permissions.name: g2-microphone
permissions.desc: Listens through the glasses microphone while listening is on, so speech can be translated between English and Japanese. Recognising your own voice (so it is not translated back) runs on your phone.

permissions.name: network
permissions.desc: Sends speech and text to Deepgram and your chosen translation service (Google Translate, OpenRouter or Anthropic) directly from your phone, using the API keys you enter. Reply suggestions use OpenRouter or Anthropic.
